name: Okta — Internal Network Login (Baseline)
xql_query:
dataset = okta_sso_raw
| filter eventType = "user.session.start"
| alter outcome_result = arrayindex(regextract(outcome, "\"result\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        ip = arrayindex(regextract(client, "\"ipAddress\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        user_name = arrayindex(regextract(actor, "\"alternateId\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0)
| filter outcome_result = "SUCCESS"
| filter incidr(ip, "10.0.0.0/8") or incidr(ip, "172.16.0.0/12") or incidr(ip, "192.168.0.0/16")
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as logins, values(ip) as ip by user_name, _time
| fields user_name, ip, logins
description: Okta user.session.start SUCCESS from an RFC1918 source IP — informational baseline for kill-chain timeline reconstruction.
